title: Two small projects I just finished
content:
I have just wrapped up GeoScore 2.4.1 and Search Gateway 1.2.0. Both projects are open source, so feel free to try them and tell me when something is inaccurate, confusing, or simply unpleasant to use.

The Search Gateway article is already published. The GeoScore guide is still being edited by hand; until it is ready, the second button will take you straight to the GeoScore service.
